symptoms: Dark brown spot concentric rings on older lower leaves
Yellowing surrounding leaf lesions
Stem leaf drop progressing upward
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_cure: Apply neem oil (2%) or copper soap fungicide spray every 7-10 days.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_cure: Spray Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb fungicide according to package instructions.
prevention: Rotate crop every 2 years
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation to keep leaves dry
Mulch soil around plants to prevent fungal spores from splashing up

symptoms: Large water-soaked gray-green spots on leaves
White fuzzy fungal growth on leaf undersides in high humidity
Rapid wilting and blackening of foliage
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_cure: Spray bio-fungicide containing Bacillus subtilis. Remove and destroy infected foliage immediately.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_cure: Apply Systemic Fungicide such as Metalaxyl + Mancozeb or Dimethomorph.
prevention: Plant blight-resistant tomato varieties
Ensure proper row spacing for maximum airflow
Destroy nightshade weed hosts near the field

symptoms: Vibrant green leaves
No visible spots, discoloration, or leaf curling
Tomato___Healthy.organic_cure: No treatment required. Maintain balanced watering and organic compost.
prevention: Maintain consistent soil moisture
Apply balanced N-P-K organic fertilizer

symptoms: Target-board concentric ring spots on lower leaf surface
Leaf tissue around lesions turns yellow and dies
Potato___Early_blight.organic_cure: Apply bio-fungicide containing Trichoderma harzianum or copper-based sprays.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_cure: Spray Dithane M-45 (Mancozeb) at 2g/liter of water.
prevention: Ensure adequate nitrogen fertility to prevent plant stress
Practice 3-year crop rotation

symptoms: Dark brown to black water-soaked leaf spots
White mold on undersides during wet weather
Tubers rot in soil
Potato___Late_blight.organic_cure: Apply Bordeaux mixture (1%) before wet weather spreads spores.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_cure: Spray Cymoxanil + Mancozeb or Propamocarb hydrochloride.
prevention: Use certified disease-free seed potatoes
Hill up soil around plants to protect tubers

symptoms: Uniform green leaves
Robust foliage growth without stem rot
prevention: Regular weed control and proper drainage

symptoms: Small cinnamon-brown pustules on upper and lower leaf surfaces
Pustules rupture releasing powdery reddish spores
Corn_(Maize)___Common_rust.organic_cure: Spray sulfur powder or neem oil solution on affected leaves.
Corn_(Maize)___Common_rust.chemical_cure: Foliar application of Azoxystrobin or Propiconazole fungicide.
prevention: Plant rust-resistant hybrid seed varieties
Plant early in the season to avoid late-summer spore exposure

symptoms: Clean long green leaves
Strong central stalk with clear silk development
prevention: Maintain adequate soil nitrogen level

symptoms: Olive-green velvet-like spots on leaves and fruit
Deformed, cracked apples with dark corky scab lesions
Apple___Apple_scab.organic_cure: Apply liquid copper or sulfur sprays in early spring at green tip stage.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_cure: Spray Myclobutanil or Captan at bud break.
prevention: Rake and destroy fallen leaves in autumn to eliminate overwintering fungus
Prune canopy for sunlight penetration

symptoms: Smooth green leaf blades
Unblemished fruit skin
prevention: Regular dormant pruning

symptoms: Oval brown lesions with yellow halo on leaves and grain
Seedling blight and seedling death
Rice___Brown_spot.organic_cure: Soak seeds in 1% neem seed kernel extract before sowing.
Rice___Brown_spot.chemical_cure: Seed treatment with Carbendazim (2g/kg seed) and spray Edifenphos or Mancozeb.
prevention: Apply balanced potassium and silicon fertilizer
Use clean, pathogen-free seed

symptoms: Bright green erect leaf blades
Strong tillers and healthy root system
prevention: Maintain optimal water level in paddy fields
